Since that fateful night, the lake has become a revered site, its name synonymous with the resilience and indomitable spirit of the Vietnamese people. The lake itself is characterized by its square shape and a deep, mossy green hue, which contrasts sharply with the dark, rusted remains of the B-52 aircraft that juts out prominently from the center.

This unique feature, a jagged and distorted metal block, serves as a powerful symbol of the nation's triumph over adversity.
